plays.description: Completion on second-and-seven; receiver stopped about a yard short of the first down.
Backpedals under pressure from Zaven Collins and throws away.
Catches Brissett's pass for four yards.
Pass intended for Trey McBride intercepted by Quentin Lake; no return yards. DB credits Braden Fiske with a quarterback hit.
Run finishes close to a first down.
Pump fake followed by an end-zone pass intended for Parkinson; Budda Baker breaks it up.
Sacked on third-and-12, back at the 28-yard line.
Makes a 44-yard field goal.
Catches a pass over the middle and advances into Rams territory; DB records 26 yards to the LA 27.
Catches a pass over the middle for a first down.
Run stopped by Aaron Donald.
Takes a hit from Aaron Donald and throws away on third-and-10.
Makes the tying field goal; DB establishes a 34-yard attempt.
Retrospective mention of a 40-yard kickoff return that set up the tying field goal. DB says Grupe forced him out and was injured on the play.
Gains five on third-and-seven, finishing about two yards short.
First-down reception gains 14 yards; tackled by Kinchens.
Runs 31 yards to the LA 10.
Handoff stopped behind the line by Young; captions call him Brian here and Byron shortly afterward.
Cannot find a receiver, is wrapped up under Byron Young's pressure, and throws away on third down.
Makes a 30-yard field goal for a 6–3 lead.
Catches a pass over the middle for three yards; immediately met by Gibbens.
Third-down reception; commentary identifies a two-man stack while anticipating a target to Puka.
Converts third-and-one on a handoff to the Arizona 16.
Fragment describes a tackle by Garrett Williams before second-and-nine.
Catches Stafford's pass and scores from 15 yards.
Sacked and fumbles on the two-point attempt. Arizona recovers but does not score; DB identifies L. Collier as the recovering player.
Under pressure on third-and-four; commentary credits Young, but the play's result is omitted.
Loses the football and falls on it inside the 15; Baker is mentioned celebrating.
Advances across the 25 and is stopped about six yards short of the marker.
Catch and run gains 18 yards across midfield; ruled down before the ball came loose.
Lunges forward to the 30 for a 10-yard gain and first down.
Breaks multiple tackles on a run for a first down to the Rams 20.
Catches a third-and-six pass for a first down.
Incomplete pass intended for Bourne.
Makes a 22-yard field goal to tie the game.
Catches a pass over the middle for 11 yards.
Reception finishes close to a first down.
Catches Brissett's pass inside the 35 for a first down; nearby commentary mentions a physical tackle by Speights.
Converts third-and-two on a run, dragging multiple Rams.
Five-yard reception to the 17; dragged down by Lake.
Eight-yard reception on third-and-14, stopped just inside the 20.
Makes a 38-yard field goal to regain the lead.
Throws downfield toward Nacua; result omitted.
Second effort produces a 13-yard run and first down to the 48.
Wide-open reception gains 16 yards to the Arizona 36.
Third-and-10 reception stopped about a yard short of the first down.
Takes a handoff on fourth down and is stopped short; commentary names Wilson as the defender.
plays.personnel_formation: Williams in backfield; Nacua in motion

plays.description: Runs 13 yards across the 35 for a first down.
Second-and-seven reception earns a first down in Rams territory.
Reception reaches the Rams 12 and earns a new set of downs.
Catches a pass to the left for a first down on second-and-one. Opening nine-yard fragment cannot confidently be assigned to this play.
Third-and-goal reception stopped immediately by Jaylen Watson.
Makes a 27-yard field goal, his fifth of the game.
Second-and-six reception gains 16 yards into Arizona territory.
Retrospective mention of a 26-yard penalty. DB identifies defensive pass interference by K. Clark on an incomplete deep-right target to Nacua; no play.
Sacked for an 11-yard loss and fumbles; recovers after McClendon's effort knocks the ball back toward him.
Eight-yard reception followed by a fumble forced by C. Simon and recovered by Arizona's D. Burke, per DB.
Takes a toss; result omitted.
Third-and-six pass bounces away; Rams defense gets off the field.
Runs 14 yards across midfield to the Arizona 46.
Second-and-three play loses two yards on a tackle by Budda Baker.
Fragment describes a first down at the 36; player and play type omitted.
Short pass goes off Williams's hands incomplete; Arizona takes over.
Catches a pass and is met by Wallace; penalty flag thrown, with enforcement omitted.
Third-and-10 throw over the middle; Wallace makes the defensive play and McVay declines a penalty. Exact pass result omitted.
Catches Stafford's pass for 43 yards to the Arizona 34. Commentary credits extra protection for giving Stafford time to find him on the backside.
Second-and-three reception earns a first down at the Arizona 13.
Catches an underneath pass out of the backfield to the Arizona 6.
Play-action reception and reach initially ruled short; DB confirms review reversed it to a six-yard touchdown.
Punter makes the extra point for a 16–15 lead.
Catches a 21-yard pass to the LA 44 on an offside free play; J. Wallace's unnecessary roughness adds 15 yards, and offside is declined.
Makes the winning 43-yard field goal, finishing six-for-six.

offense_strengths: McBride supplied a 26-yard reception and several additional chain-moving catches; Higgins, Bourne and Wilson also contributed first downs.
Knight produced a 31-yard left-end run, a later 13-yard run and another first-down run through multiple tackles.
Brooks's late 21-yard reception plus unnecessary roughness positioned Ryland for the winner.
Ryland converted all six field goals and supplied all 18 points.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Corum's 15-yard receiving touchdown and Parkinson's six-yard play-action touchdown.
Allowed Nacua's 43-yard reception and another first-down catch during the late touchdown drive.
K. Clark's defensive pass interference conceded 26 yards.

offense_strengths: Corum converted a short-yardage third down, ran for 13 yards and scored on a 15-yard reception.
Adams supplied two explicitly described 16-yard receptions.
Late completions to Nacua, Williams and Parkinson produced a touchdown drive and the temporary lead.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Knight's 31-yard run and subsequent productive runs.
Allowed repeated Arizona first-down receptions to McBride, Higgins, Bourne and Wilson.
Conceded Brooks's late 21-yard reception, then added 15 yards through Wallace's unnecessary roughness.

limitations: Captions only; no frames inspected and no commands run. The supplied DB is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not mean a play did not occur. Fragmentary plays are retained with unknown details; the isolated second-down pass fragment at 03:14 cannot establish a separate play. No specific coverage scheme is explicitly tied to a snap: general discussion of increased Rams man coverage and safety help on McBride does not establish individual-play coverage. The one-on-one remark at 10:44 does not establish a coverage scheme. Formations are included only when explicitly tied to the sequence. defender_beaten lists identified tacklers where available, as requested; this does not establish that those defenders lost coverage. Unmatched names retain caption wording where identity is uncertain. Null yards indicate unavailable or inapplicable yardage; field-goal yards are kick distances, penalty yards are enforcement distances, and Brooks's 21 excludes the added penalty. The earlier Ryland kick is incorrectly recalled as 44 yards in captions; the supplied DB establishes 34. DB-only plays without identifiable caption references are omitted.
